_about: Expected result for every authority and quotation in tests/drafts. 'error' describes the planted mistake; null means the item is correct. 'expect' lists the statuses that count as the right answer against the offline demo library. 'expect_live' overrides it for scripts/score.py --live, for the few items where the real corpus honestly supports a different answer than six saved judgments can; where it is absent, 'expect' applies to both backends. See docs/live-run-2026-10-09.md.
